description:
Ja Wangnan can’t seem to pass the 20th Floor. Even after failing time and time again, he refuses to give up. On his journey, he meets a mysterious and powerful character named Viole. Wangnan invites Viole to join his team of Regulars. Their journey continues with new challenges at every turn.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

alternative: クン · アゲロ · アグネス

node.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Rank:__ Regular
__Position:__ Light Bearer

Khun Aguero Agnis is a E-Rank Regular from Khun Family, and is often referred to simply as "Khun". He is a best friend of [Twenty-Fifth Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam), one of the main protagonists of Tower of God.

Khun relies heavily on his master intellect, however, this is not his only strong field. He also has exceptional physical attributes and is a skilled Light Bearer. His powers in combat cannot be denied.

__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 168 cm (Part 1), 180 cm (Part II)
__Rank:__ Irregular
__Position:__ Wave Controller
__Born:__  ~!Floor of Death!~__Occupation:__  ~!FUG Slayer Candidate!~

Twenty-Fifth Baam is an Irregular and one of the main protagonists of Tower of God. Bam entered in search of his best friend [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/135466/Rachel), and after passing Headon's test he was deemed worthy to climb the Tower.

In Part I, he is a highly empathetic and caring young man, understanding little of life, having had virtually no contact with people before meeting Rachel and later entering the Tower. He hates loneliness and other people's loneliness. He is considered very naive and knows little about the Tower. During Part I, his only reason for climbing the Tower is to be with Rachel.

In Part II:
~!
He was forced to join FUG, and received then the name of Jue Viole Grace (쥬 비올레 그레이스), the Slayer Candidate, to keep his real identity hidden. As Viole, he is far more violent. He now has friends to protect and will not hesitate to fight if it means protecting them. He now completely understands that in order to climb the Tower, he must be pre-emptive and prepared to engage in combat and eradicate all opposition. He's become more introverted, rarely ever speaking or displaying any signs of emotion. He's also quite cold and calculating, interacting with others only out of necessity and will take advantage of a situation to defeat his opponents.

Later in the Part as FUG's hold on him weakens, he begins to be more expressive and talkative. Later, when he officially meets with Khun and Rak for the first time in seven years, he smiles happily and embraces them, showing that his original personality that he had hidden away to protect himself from FUG's influence was resurfacing.
!~


In Part III:
~!
He is completely back to his normal self, with the addition of some improvements in areas such as confidence. He additionally dropped the 'Viole' look and sticks with an updated 'Baam' look. He is still often called both Baam and Viole now. He now goes through new questions such as what to do when he can't save everyone, and old questions, such as why everyone can't just get along, but he is more accepting of things than before, all the while continually fighting stronger enemies and becoming stronger.
!~

alternative: ラーク・レクレイシャー

node.description:
__Species:__ Wraithraiser, ~!Native One!~ __Height:__ 3m (Decompressed) __Rank:__ Regular C-Rank __Position:__ Spear Bearer Rak Wraithraiser is a Regular. He unwillingly teamed up with [Baam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Baam) and [Khun](https://anilist.co/character/84781/Khun-Aguero-Agnis) during the first test on the Second Floor and passed other tests with them. He was selected for the Spear Bearer position. He is a large and powerful warrior and a very confident individual.
Rak is originally a 3 meter tall creature, but after he mocked the Ranker [Yu Han Sung](https://anilist.co/character/141286/Sung-Yu-Han), the Second Floor Test Director, his body was shrunken by them. He eventually found out how to get back to his original size. As a being who can control their body size, he is a Compression Licenser.
He is a direct descendant of the Native One, a type of being that is able to rule over the elements in the Tower.
Rak doesn't come off as particularly smart; he thinks he's superior to almost everyone else and so refers to other people as "turtles". He occasionally calls himself "Rakleader" when he is feeling particularly full of himself, although Khun may be to blame for indulging him. He tries to make himself appear tough, although he's actually a bit of a baby sometimes. However, he does seem to have a little of a caring side in him.

alternative: エンドロシ・ザハード

node.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Endorsi Jahad is a Regular and one of Jahad's Princesses, currently climbing the Tower. Among Regulars, Endorsi is unmatched in terms of physical ability. Among the Jahad's Princesses, she is fairly warm and more human.

Her parents weren't around when she was born. She was then adopted by a couple from the Middle Area before she became a princess. Later, her adoptive parents were killed by Snake Charmer.

Her character concept is that of a 'Normal modern girl' taking great care of her looks, stressed about her weight, wanting to hear she is pretty while acting confident. A girl who is yet to mature fully.

Endorsi doesn't believe in being friends with a guy at first and says that guys and girls cannot be friends and can only be boyfriend and girlfriend and later states that she is not allowed to date anyone because she is a Princess of Jahad, but later on she catches feelings for [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Baam) and calls Bam her boyfriend.

Ha Yuri Jahad, more commonly known as Yu​ri Jahad (lacking her family name), is a High Ranker and Princess from the Ha Family. Notably, she is one of the most famous Princesses and therefore highly favored, with much political influence throughout The Tower.

~!She is the owner of Black March and Green April, two of the 13 Month Series. She is the first Princess to own two 13 Months at the same time since Garam Jahad. Notably, she is one of the most famed Princesses, and perhaps one of the most favored.!~

__Species:__ Red Witch
__Height:__ 168 cm 
__Rank:__ Regular
__Position:__ Wave Controller, Scout, Guide

Hwaryun is a quiet person who says little and she has a gloomy and ominous aura. She is also quite manipulative.

In Part II, she's depicted as mischievous and teasing, as she clearly mocked the Viole impostor and repeatedly called him "Pig". She almost always smiles in mischief and probably a little bit of arrogance. She also tends to be extremely blunt, caring very little about other peoples' feelings; though this could be considered her way of spurring a person on. This leads her to seem very harsh.

Hwaryun is Viole's Guide but is also the Guide for FUG's Rankers notably Ha Jinsung. ~!It was revealed that she went into the Floor of Death first, instructing another Red-haired lady to lead the way for Yuri and Khun's team.!~

__Species:__ Human
__Born:__ Outside
__Height:__ 195 cm
__Rank:__ Irregular, High Ranker #4 (Currently)
__Position:__ Fisherman
__Occupation:__ Wolhaiksong (Vice Captain)

Urek Mazino is an Irregular, currently 4th in Rank. He was the strongest active Ranker before [Jahad](https://anilist.co/character/126030/Jahad) became active once again. He is also the most recent person to be part of the Top 5 High Rankers inside the Tower.

He is considered to be on the same level as Phantaminum by weaker Rankers, however, his true rank is almost impossible to determine in terms of the Top 4 ranks because the top 2 Rankers are inactive and thus, cannot be compared with Urek. He mentioned to [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam) on the 43rd Floor that they would meet again later on the 77th Floor, then left the floor. His current location is unknown.

Urek is said to have a ruthless personality, leading him to be respected by all those who dare call themselves men and at the same time seems to be disliked by seemingly every woman he meets. He is also shown to be extremely confident to the point of arrogance, often ridiculing the efforts of those who were no match for him. Despite his ruthlessness and boastful nature, he still wants to help others and friends in need. He will also help strangers if he thinks they are "worthy" to be helped. He respects one's courage, determination, and nobility.

Lero-Ro is a former Examiner of the Second Floor. He is an exceptionally strong Ranker, to the point that even Quant, also a former Test Administrator (and a haughty one), would constantly boast about his strength. He was supposedly the strongest Second Floor Test Administrator and is particularly skilled in the use of Shinsoo. He was also the Light Bearer position instructor. He is fairly old, older than Yuri Zahard, as he stated that Anak Zahard didn't live up to a Princess's chaotic expectations like Yuri Zahard did, whom he met when they were both Regulars. He and Quant are awkwardly described as a "Set Menu", explained by the fact that Lero-Ro and Quant climbed the Tower together like a team. He is apparently quite famous, and he took over 300 years to climb the Tower.

__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 167cm
__Position:__ Scout

Hatsu (하츠, Hahcheu; or "Hatz") is a Regular and a "devoutly" practising swordsman. He is a quiet and calm warrior, who has been making good progress in the tests merely by doing exactly what each test entails. 

~!He teamed up with [Anaak Jahad](https://anilist.co/character/135470/Anaak-Jahad) and [Shibisu](https://anilist.co/character/137957/Shibisu) during the first test on the 2nd Floor and later signed Khun's friend list.!~

~!He was last seen on the 52nd Floor having helped [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/Twentyfifth-Bam) and his allies.!~

Anaak is introduced in the second floor, where she forms a team with Shibisu and Hatz.

~!She introduces herself as one of Jahad's Princesses, but it's later revealed that she's actually the daughter of the real Anaak Jahad, who was impregnated by her lover and ran into hiding. Though she is only a demi-princess because of the diluted Jahad's blood in her, she used to possess two of the 13 Month Series at one point; something only a few Princesses have accomplished. She is climbing the Tower for revenge.!~

__Species:__ Human
__Rank:__ Extra

Rachel, also known as Michelle Light was Baam's best and only friend as she was the only one to visit him in his "cave". She longs to see the stars which is one of the fabled rewards waiting at the top of the Tower, because she "fears the Night".
~!Like Baam she is an Irregular.!~

Ja Wangnan aspires to be the king of the whole Tower. He values his determination in life more than anyone else's desires. He plans to scale up the Tower's Floors and reach the true top of the Tower, unlike those who have given up.

Jin-Seong Ha is a High Ranker of the Ha Family and a member of FUG. Jinsung has a carefree and fun-loving attitude, although this also serves as a mask to hide his true intentions. Since meeting Baam, his character has mellowed slightly to the point where he feels regret at the FUG's treatment of Baam.
As a member of the Ha Family and one of the top 100 High Rankers, Jinsung is an incredibly powerful High Ranker, extremely skilled with martial arts and incredibly physically powerful, his status heightening the standards one would expect of him.

Additionally, even the Elders and Slayers of FUG are wary of angering him, speaking volumes about his strength, with Khel Hellam commenting it was a waste to lose someone as powerful as Jinsung and Kallavan noted that Jinsung is far stronger than Karaka, one of the Slayers. In fact, he is such a monster that Hwa Ryun stated that even a Slayer would have trouble against him in a serious fight.

Shibisu is a D-rank Regular. He is relatively weak, yet possesses a great ability to deduce and an intellect on par with Khun's. Nonetheless, he made it past all of the tests on the Second Floor, where he was assigned the Scout position and is now climbing the Tower as the leader of his team.

Phonsekal Lauroe is a Regular and a talented Wave Controller of the Eurasia Family. He loves to sleep and goes everywhere with blanket and his pillows. Despite his sloth, he is an exceptional Wave Controller, capable of firing powerful long-range blasts.

Ran Khun is a Regular currently climbing the Tower. He was formerly Khun's teammate and was also formerly a member of the FUG team created for Jue Viole Grace. He often describes situations or people that are troublesome as 'annoying'. After the events of the Workshop Battle, he formed into a new team with Khun's direction. He is also from the same branch of the Khun family as Mascheny Jahad.

Ehwa Yeon, known by some as the "Yeon Family's Flare", is a member of the Yeon Family one of the 10 Great Families. She is a Regular climbing with the rest of her team, having recently participated in the Workshop Battle.

Yu Han Sung is an Advanced Ranker and the former Test Director of the Second Floor. Notably, he is a key member of FUG in taking Viole to the top. He is the main antagonist of Part I. He is a well known ranker partly because he rejected becoming a High Ranker.

Headon is the Guardian of the First Floor and is the caretaker of the Tower. He has an appearance reminiscent of a white rabbit because of his long ears.

Headon talks in a friendly tone, but has been shown to have a cruel and manipulative streak. He presents his ideas and opinions in a logical and pragmatic manner, but his goals and desires themselves are not understood. He is perfectly willing to manipulate dozens of lives and create the nucleus of civil unrest to attain his mysterious goal.

Although most Administrators normally stay on their Floors, Headon seems to be the only Administrator with the ability to visit other Floors of the Tower. It is said that Headon is the most experienced Administrator of the Tower. Although that only means he was the first Administrator Zahard met and therefore the first one to carry out the roles of a Administrator, that doesn't mean he's the oldest.
Karaka is a Slayer in FUG. His secret hideout is located on the 97th Floor.
Serena Rinnen is a Regular who passed most of the tests on the Second Floor and was assigned the Scout position.

alternative: エヴァン・エドロック

node.description: Evan Edrok is a High Ranker as well the Chief Guide of Zahard Royalty, which is a unique position in the Tower. He always seems to follow his partner, Ha Yuri Zahard.

__Sobriquet__: Aloof Wave
__Rank__: 14

Po Bidau Gustang is the head of the Po Bidau Family, one of the 10 Great Warriors and the first living being to systematically record Shinsoo. Po Bidau Gustang is the Tower’s most famous Wave Controller and writer. Excluding the eccentrics within The Workshop, he probably knows the most about The Tower. He is shown to be an arrogant individual, with such great reputation and influence in his family, that even his family members think he has omniscient intellect.
Quant Blitz is a Ranker. He instructed the Scout position while he was a Test Admin on the Second Floor.

Khun Maschenny Jahad is a Top 100 High Rankers in the Tower from the Khun Family and the owner of the Yellow May, one of the 13 Month Series. She is the only Jahad's Princesses in the Khun Family to be awarded with a 13 Months. She is a direct descendant of Khun Edahn and Khun Maschenny.
Xia Xia is an D-rank Regular and Light Bearer that used to live on the 28th Floor as an information seller.

Hoh is a seemingly cheerful person who is actually quite conflicted. Making his way up the tower, dealing with flashbacks of the past in his homeplace, and making friends, he struggles to make his way.

Khun Hachuling, or simply just Hachuling, is a Ranker, a defected member of the Khun Family and one of the numerous children related to Khun Eduan. He is also a member of Wolhaiksong and is sometimes referred to as Blueberry.

Dede Kancho is a Regular found in the Second Floor.

~!He made it through most of the Second Floor tests, teaming up with Shopin and Kon, but eventually failed. !~

alternative: ホーン・アークラブター

node.description:
Hon Arkraptor is a Regular and a member of Team Sweet and Sour.

~!Arkraptor married a woman from the 10 Great Families. They had a baby girl together, but his wife's family took his spouse and child from him.!~

Kang Horyang is an E-Rank Regular and a Spear Bearer. He is a massive, brooding man with a strange mark floating above his right shoulder which under normal circumstances makes him look like a one-winged angel. His upper body and possibly lower body seems to be wrapped in black bandages, which have buttons.
Parakewl is a rather unintelligent and useless Regular.
Sunwoo Nare is a Regular who came to the Tower for money. She made it through all the tests on the Second Floor and was assigned the Scout position.

Mule Love is a Ranker and an Administrator on the 20th Floor. He was born into the Mule Family and also belongs to the Chicken Love Club. He became a Wonsulsa after passing a certain Test at the Research Association.
Novick is a Regular and a Spear Bearer originating from one of the Ha Family's branches.

Quaetro Blitz is an C-rank Regular. Although he failed the test on the 28th Floor once, he appeared on the 30th Floor for the Workshop Battle. 

~!After the Dallar Show that took place on the Hell Express, he left the train and went to the Cage with Chang Blarode. He was last seen among the other Regulars listening to Khun's presentation before the battle of the Nest.!~
Beta is one of Sophia Amae's "children" and Horyang and Cassano's "brother", a living Ignition weapon created by the Workshop.

Vespa (베스파, Beseupa) is a humanoid being with a bee-like theme, climbing the Tower alongside several members of Ship's Team. She is a Regular and front-liner combatant with considerable skill. Her Position is a Scout. She is able to transform into an adult form.
Aleksai Amigochaz is the red-winged Regular from early 2nd Floor who had been climbing the Tower with Shibisu, Anak Zahard and Androssi Zahard as a member of Team Isu. His position is a Spear Bearer.
Yeo Miseng is a Regular who climbs the Tower in search of her parents.
Yeo Goseng is a Regular and Light Bearer.
Nya Nia is a Regular working as a Jjamppong delivery boy on the 20th Floor. He later quits his job to take part in the Tests.
Prince is the son of the president of the company Lurker Cash. He is a Regular and a Light Bearer.
Augusgus is a High Ranker and Test Director in charge of the 20th Floor. He is also a member of FUG.

Edin Dan is a D-rank Regular Scout that has incredible speed ability since he was still an E-rank Regular. He rested for some years on the 25th Floor, but was forced to continue climbing by Khun Aguero Agnis

Sophia Amae is one of Workshop Researchers assistant in charge to teach Beniamino Cassano and Kang Horyang about languages and basic human interaction until the boys reached the age of 12. She was working with the Living Ignition Weapon projects of The Workshop, currently focusing with Emily.
Jaina Repellista Zahard is a Zahard's Princess from the Jaina Family. She seems to be addicted to sitting in her darkened room in front of her Lighthouse watching what's happening within The Tower.

Beniamino Cassano is one of the first Human experiment subjects of The Workshop in order to create Living Ignition Weapon. He is a D-Rank Regular and a Scout. He was a former member of Team FUG and Team Rachel.

Chang Blarode is a C-Rank Regular and a Fisherman who was the part of the Top 5 E-Rank Regulars.

~!He is later revealed to be half-human and half-canine.!~
Verdi is a notorious Anima on Shibisu's Team.
Kim Lurker is a shylock and Assistant Manager working for Lurker Cash.
Varagarv is one of the Three Mad Dogs of Baylord Yama, a Slayer from FUG.
Reflejo was a Regular and a former Fisherman of Team FUG led by Jue Viole Grace during the 30F Workshop Battle. He spent thousands of years in the E-Rank level hiding as a sleeper agent for FUG.
Madorako is a High Ranker and leader of the Grey Catfish Merchant Association. He is known for being an expert businessman.
Yuje is a Wolhaiksong member who worked undercover as a Test Administrator on the 21st Floor.

Michael is a Regular and a Wave Controller first seen on the 25th Floor. He was a quack doctor in Khun's team and was also called a missionary. Not including Khun and Rachel, he was ranked fifth in the team.

~!He is an associate of FUG and was hired to infiltrate the team and kill Khun. He later appeared as one of the members of Rachel's group.!~
Traveller or Mr. Traveller is a mysterious unnamed Regular, who was first seen being chased by an unidentified Workshop Patrol during the beginning of Workshop Battle at 30th Floor.
Apple is a Regular and an Information collecting type Scout and Light Bearer.~!She is a Regular that was contacted by FUG to infiltrate Khun's team and kill him.!~
Tebo & Lebo are two beings who are actually one entity. They are a Regulars that participated in the Workshop Battle.

Rapdevil is a Regular nicknamed "Devil of the Right Arm" because of his ability to transform his right arm into a black and blue striped 'Power mode'. He had been hired to travel with a rich company owner's son. He claimed to have defeated Hatz, who apparently is a well-known swordsman and Regular in the Tower. 

~!However, it is later revealed that he is in fact only a fake, using the reputation of Beniamino Cassano, the real Devil of the Right Arm.!~

Devil Bon is a Regular that was involved in the Workshop Battle that took place on the Archimedes. 

~!He was later revealed to be one of three gamblers hired by FUG to eliminate Khun Aguero Agnis and Team Sweet & Sour.!~
Ron Mei is a Regular from FUG and was the appointed leader of Team Mad Dog at the 30F Workshop Battle event. Her position is Light Bearer. She is an "Angel" of Mad Dog Varagarv.
Noma is a Test Admin on the 21st Floor who was in charge of the Zygaena's Flower test.

Gyetang was a Regular and a Spear Bearer first seen on the 25th Floor. He was a fan of Endorsi Zahard and had joined Khun's team to get a chance to meet her. He was also the team's cook, though his teammate Novick was said to have been the best cook of his team.
